title: Runescape Dragonwilds - Combat Training + Multi-Skill Guide
author: My Dude Games
description:
This short video will give you plenty of resources to max out your combat!

Sorry for the delay between the last video, I have been trying a few things to improve my next videos.

Once again, I appreciate your support and I look forward to help you on your journey!

transcript.text: In this video, we're going to explore the best way to level up your combat. I'll show you the fastest methods and
also the multi-skill methods. This is the first video of the series. There is more coming, so buckle up and let's dive
into it. Before we start, let me remind you of the potions that are available to you.
For XP, we only have combat potions. For melee and magic, you can do the combat potion, but I'm not going to suggest you
to do that. In my opinion, it's a waste of resources. Don't ask me why, but range doesn't have anything. Pause the
video now, craft the potions you need, and let's do this. I believe the easiest way to train combat alone is to place
lodestone in front of every single vault. I'm going to suggest you just to go in, do the boss room, and get out.
That way you don't waste your time on puzzles and walking around the vault. Now, I'm going to specify melee. Go to
this exact location. You're going to be circling around this tower. You're going to kill multiple enemies as well as
collecting some ingredients for cooking. At this point in time, I'm going to suggest you to go with the abyssal whip.
Not only is one of the best weapons of the game, but also you can wear a shield with it, which is going to make your
life a lot easier. So, by using this strategy, you're going to go around this tower, kill all the mobs, and get some
ingredients, and at the end, you're probably going to have a lot of experience and over 100 ingredients for
cooking. You can repeat this method every single day, which for me means that this is one of the best methods you
can use. Now, let's go over range and magic. I'm going to put those two together because
they have low defense and they require a different kind of training. For this method, I recommend the northeast vault
of fractured planes. Inside the vault, you're going to notice that there is a broken bridge. We're going to use that
to our advantage. So, in one side of the bridge, we have the boss room, and the other side of the bridge, we have a lot
of mobs. If you haven't figured out yet, we're going to lure the monsters to the bridge. That way we can keep distance
from them, and they cannot reach us physically. Also, be shy and use the walls to protect yourself if needed. The
boss room is very straightforward. However, the mobs can be a little overwhelming. I'm going to show you guys
how I do it. If you have range level 18, you have hunter senses, which mean if you crouch, you can review all enemies
close by. That will give you leverage to plan out how you want to tackle this. You can also use the skill snare, which
is going to help you a lot. And if it hits the fan, you just run to the bridge. The vault have a lot of
resources, so feel free to train other skills while you do that. Now for our last destination, we're
going to go to Stormtouch Highlands. I like to start at the top, that way you can get most of the enemies from behind.
Inside this castle, you're going to find the boss is a little bit challenging, but it's fun. On the path, you're going
to find a lot of sheep as well, that's free XP. Just kill them, as well as multiple resources like cooking
materials, geysers, or deposits, two chests. Make sure to bring potions and anti-poison. You can alternate this
route with the first one I showed you guys, and you're going to have multiple resources at the end of it, which will
facilitate when you want to train another skill. For the weapon choice, I'm using the crossbow because that's
simply the best weapon of the game for now, but you can use the bow as well. It's pretty fun to use. The stack bow is
the best bow of the game currently. This area is not range and magic friendly, so
use your spells at your advantage here. My main recommendation is to use snare. If you're planning to train magic here,
make sure to have at least the Draconic staff or the staff of light. It's not a bad idea to stock up on iron ore. I bet
when the steel gets introduced, we're going to need iron ore and coal. For my next video, I'm planning to do mining.
If you guys want to see something different, please let me know down below in the comments. If you enjoy content
like that, please let me know down below. Also, this is a new channel. I appreciate the support of you guys.
Thank you so much, and I'll see you on the next one. Peace.
